label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), almost only when the reward input is 1, and specifically when the previous trial was a1 that went rarely to S2 and was rewarded (a rare-rewarded a1 trial; the model-based cue to switch to a2). Equivalent to prev_state == 2 & prev_action == 1 & prev_reward == 1. Uses only observed history. Dev: P 0.74, R 0.75, F1 0.74, mass recall 0.90; the strong activations (top three quartiles) are about 90% covered. Misses are mostly very weak activations on other rewarded D1 steps (e.g. common-rewarded a1 trials), plus rel -3 D1 steps where the previous trial lies outside the window. It does not fire after rewarded a2 trials (S1 rare or S2 common), after unrewarded trials, or at GO/D2. About a quarter of predicted steps stay silent; precision rises to 0.85 when the trial two back was rewarded, so recent reward history raises the chance of firing, but adding that condition lowers recall. Late-episode trials (90-99) rarely fire.
